items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All six asks covered: file/event SourceRef kinds mirrored client+server with parity test, parseEvidence licenses quotes for all known kinds, view shows project - path - line N / event id as plain text, guard needle + structured audit, fixture pinned with sha256, contract doc updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: decodeURIComponent wrapped in try/catch; every malformed pointer falls back to unknown source with the raw text, never throws.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Plain text only (React text nodes, no link); decoded components with control/format/separator characters are refused so bidi tricks cannot reorder the label; 1024-char cap; WebUI never opens the cited file or event.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 41 server tests (31 refusal cases, length boundary, countersign 400/200, audit shape, fixture hash), 5 client view tests reading the pinned fixture, mirror drift guard, e2e on isolated stack.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Regexes have disjoint alternatives with a literal separator (no catastrophic backtracking); the 1024 cap runs before the file/event regexes.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Pointer grammar split into its own mirrored module to keep the grammar files under 300 lines; session kind keeps the name known for compatibility, documented in the type comment.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer leadwright renderEntry -> decisions-proposed.md -> WebUI parser: byte-pinned fixture round-trips (LF, CRLF, BOM probes). Producer WebUI countersign -> audit.jsonl -> consumer leadwright parseDecisionAudit: real probe read both keys, zero damaged lines.
